headline.en: Keep release facts and configuration changes together.
headline.zh: 把发布信息与配置变化放在一起。

sub.en: dropbrief combines registered repository status, quantization listings and selected configuration-field differences into a cached release brief.
sub.zh: dropbrief 将登记仓库状态、量化列表与选定配置字段差异组合成缓存发布简报。

body.en: Release metadata and prior configuration share one brief.
body.zh: 发布元数据与前版配置组合为简报。

body.en: Differences retain old and new values.
Offline mode can consume a previously saved brief.
body.zh: 离线模式可读取已有简报。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Compare two complete synthetic configurations with a changed hidden_size and a renamed bookkeeping field.
note.zh: 比较两份完整合成配置，其中 hidden_size 变化，记录性名称字段也被修改。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Compare two explicit synthetic model configurations with the production field-diff engine; no live release status, deployment compatibility or migration recommendation.

body.en: Compare two complete synthetic configurations with a changed hidden_size and a renamed bookkeeping field.
body.zh: 比较两份完整合成配置，其中 hidden_size 变化，记录性名称字段也被修改。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/dropbrief.git
cd dropbrief
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

limitations.en: An available file listing does not establish that its quantization runs on your hardware.
limitations.zh: 文件列表显示可用，不代表该量化能在你的硬件运行。

limitations.en: Unchanged compared fields do not prove identical architecture or that capability gains came from training. The diff excludes several bookkeeping and token fields.
limitations.zh: 被比较字段不变，不证明架构完全相同，也不证明能力提升来自训练。diff 会排除部分记录与 token 字段。

limitations.en: The switch hint is a simple heuristic, not a deployment recommendation. Snapshots describe their recorded time, not current availability.
limitations.zh: 切换提示是简单启发式，不是部署建议；快照反映记录时刻，不代表当前可用性。

body.en: Before downloading a model update, operators need the available artifacts and configuration differences in one place. A saved brief also gives an offline environment a dated snapshot to inspect.
body.zh: 下载模型更新前，运维需要集中查看可用产物与配置差异。保存的简报也能为离线环境提供可检查的带时间快照。

body.en: The registry resolves model aliases and prior versions. Fetch collects configured HTTP metadata into a cache; archdiff compares flattened selected fields. Briefing combines those records with a rule-based switch hint, while snapshot loads saved briefs without a live fetch.
body.zh: 登记表解析模型别名和前一版本；fetch 将配置 HTTP 元数据存入缓存；archdiff 比较展开后的选定字段；briefing 组合记录与规则式切换提示，snapshot 可不联网读取保存简报。

body.en: The registry resolves model aliases and prior versions. Fetch collects configured HTTP metadata into a cache; archdiff compares flattened selected fields. Briefing combines those records with a rule-based switch hint, while snapshot loads saved briefs without a live fetch.
body.zh: 登记表解析模型别名和前一版本；fetch 将配置 HTTP 元数据存入缓存；archdiff 比较展开后的选定字段；briefing 组合记录与规则式切换提示，snapshot 可不联网读取保存简报。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: docs/model-families.yaml owns registered model aliases, sources and prior_alias. DROPBRIEF_CACHE_DIR selects the cache; DROPBRIEF_SNAPSHOT_DIR selects saved snapshots. Offline snapshots ship inside the package, so `dropbrief brief --offline` works from any install.
body.zh: docs/model-families.yaml 定义模型别名、源和 prior_alias。DROPBRIEF_CACHE_DIR 指定缓存，DROPBRIEF_SNAPSHOT_DIR 指定保存快照。离线快照随包分发，任意安装方式均可运行离线简报。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
dropbrief families
dropbrief brief --offline qwen3.8-27b
# Network access is used by online status:
dropbrief status <registered-alias>
